text:
SECOND INSTANCE OF THE SAME MEASUREMENT ERROR, recorded here because this bead is where the first one was corrected.

Testing the six lowering routes in measurement_form, a single-shot timing pass in fixed order gave a 1.67x spread with auto as the slowest of six - which would have been a genuine defect, an automatic selector choosing the worst available strategy. Re-measured with a discarded warm-up, three repetitions, and the sweep repeated in reverse order, everything clusters between 0.89 and 1.06 seconds and auto is mid-pack in both directions.

Warm-up artifact, exactly like the 40x figure corrected on this bead.

The durable lesson for anyone doing performance work here: the real effects are smaller than the noise a naive harness introduces. Discard a warm-up pass, repeat, and reverse the order before believing any ratio. Both false results today were dramatic - 40x and 1.67x with a clear ordering - and both evaporated under control.
